name: Mitoya Sena
source:
A Japanese-style beauty with sharp eyes. Contrary to her dignified appearance, she has a cheerful mischievous personality. She likes making pranks and laughing, when she goes too far she ends up having to write a written apology.

Among the vigilantes, she has a soft spot for Fuuka, and likes flirting with her. She's the type to solve her problems by acting before thinking. She is a master swordsman and his very good at close combat.

"If I believe the person to be evil, I will not hesitate to point my sword for justice."


Ability: Sixth Senses
Strengthen insight around her surroundings.
[spoiler]True ability: Reproduction
She can copy a single ability users body type but not the ability itself.[/spoiler]
